g.text: Cooper–Jacob late-time confined-aquifer approximation with constant pumping and negligible well losses in the observation well. s=Q/(4πT)ln(2.25Tt/(r²S));
the extrapolated zero intercept is not onset of pumping or zero early-time drawdown. Valid displayed interval has Theis u≤0.01. Boundaries and leakage are
